annotations.title: Status of a human card appraisal order

description: RAIL: HUMAN CARD. Status and collection for buy_appraisal orders only, keyed by orderId + orderToken. Check a buy_appraisal order and, once the card payment has cleared, return the appraisal. Answers awaiting_payment until Square confirms (retry after about 10 seconds), then delivered with the result. Every later call returns the same stored appraisal. A paid order that cannot be delivered reports refunded. Not for the other rails: an enrolled-card charge is read with appraisal_card_order_status (operationId); a prepaid-balance purchase is read with appraisal_purchase_status (operationId).
name: appraisal_order_status
title: Status of a human card appraisal order
